name: Concept 1: Christmas AR Message
description:
Concept 1: Christmas AR Message
Price: Imagine that a new personalized video scratch card has just been launched!

🎁 This Christmas gift scratch card is sold for 250 CZK and guarantees a win for the recipient — making it an ideal gift under the Christmas tree.

On the front side of the card, there is a QR code that can be scanned with a phone. After scanning, you can record a short video where you wish the recipient a Merry Christmas. A festive filter with a holiday design 🎄 is automatically added to the video.

When the recipient scratches the card, discovers their prize, and scans the QR code, your personal greeting will appear directly above the card — brought to life through augmented reality and fun digital effects.

Available at all sales points where scratch cards are sold, or online through relevant websites and apps.

name: Concept 2: Elf Yourself
description:
Concept 2: Elf Yourself
Price: Imagine a fun new AR-themed scratch card with an interactive twist!

🎁 This Christmas gift scratch card sells for 250 CZK and guarantees a win.

After scanning the QR code on the front, you can write a short Christmas greeting for the recipient. You can then upload a photo or selfie, which will appear on the bodies of dancing elves — creating a playful personalized Christmas video in the popular “Elf Yourself” style 🎅.

When the recipient scratches their card and scans the QR code, they’ll see your message turn into a fun video of dancing elves featuring your face.

Available in stores and online like other scratch cards.

name: Concept 3: AR Christmas Mini Game
description:
Concept 3: AR Christmas Mini Game
Price: Imagine being able to play a new AR mini-game on your scratch card!

🎁 This Christmas scratch card sells for 250 CZK and guarantees a win.

After scanning the QR code, you can write a greeting and upload a photo or selfie. When the recipient scratches and scans the card, they’ll enter a virtual winter scene with hills, snowballs, and walls.

Your uploaded photo turns into a playful 3D avatar hiding behind obstacles and throwing virtual snowballs. The user can throw snowballs back to win the game.

Available in stores and online.

name: Concept 4: Christmas Lip Sync
description:
Concept 4: Christmas Lip Sync
Price: Imagine adding a lip-sync video experience to your scratch card!

🎁 This Christmas scratch card sells for 250 CZK and guarantees a win.

After scanning the QR code, you can record a quick video message wishing the recipient Merry Christmas. Choose a festive filter and your favorite Christmas carol to lip-sync to!

When the recipient scratches and scans the QR code, they’ll see your festive video with lyrics displayed — so they can sing along with you 🎤.

Available in stores and online.

name: Concept 5: Christmas Duet
description:
Concept 5: Christmas Duet
Price: Imagine a new scratch card with a duet lip-sync experience!

🎁 This Christmas card costs 250 CZK and guarantees a win.

After scanning, you record a festive message and lip-sync to a Christmas song. When the recipient scratches and scans the card, they can record themselves singing along with you.

The final duet video can then be shared via messaging apps or social media.

Available in stores and online.

name: Concept 6: Christmas Cake Surprise
description:
Concept 6: Christmas Cake Surprise
Occasion: Christmas
Features:
- Imagine adding a personal surprise to your Christmas scratch card!

🎁 After scanning the QR code, you can upload a photo or selfie and choose a festive character (Santa, elf, reindeer).

When the recipient scratches and scans, they’ll get instructions to place a virtual cake using world tracking AR. As they approach, your character “jumps out of the cake”!

The recipient’s reaction is recorded, and the whole scene is replayed as a shareable video with your holiday message.

Available in stores and online.
